web.markdown:
# Use Dark Mode on your iPhone and iPad

Turn on Dark Mode for a great viewing experience in low-light environments.

## Turn on Dark Mode in Settings

1. In the Settings app, tap Appearance.

2. Select Dark to turn on Dark Mode.
![iPhone screen showing Appearance settings with Light and Dark mode options.](https://cdsassets.apple.com/live/7WUAS350/images/ios/ios-27-iphone-17-pro-settings-appearance.png)

In iOS 26 and earlier, [tap Display & Brightness in the Settings app](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/adjust-screen-brightness-color-balance-iph60ba71065/26/ios/26) to find the Dark Mode options.

## Turn on Dark Mode in Control Center

1. Open Control Center on your [iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-us/108330) or [iPad](https://support.apple.com/en-us/111790).

2. Touch and hold the brightness bar.

3. Select Dark Mode![](https://cdsassets.apple.com/live/7WUAS350/images/inline-icons/dark-mode-icon.png) to turn it on or off.


## Add Dark Mode to Control Center

If you don’t see Dark Mode in Control Center, you can add it.

1. Open Control Center on your [iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-us/108330) or [iPad](https://support.apple.com/en-us/111790).

2. Touch and hold a blank space in the Control Center to edit the screen.

3. Tap Add a Control at the bottom of the screen and select Dark Mode![](https://cdsassets.apple.com/live/7WUAS350/images/inline-icons/dark-mode-icon.png) to add it to the Control Center.


## Set Dark Mode to turn on automatically

1. In the Settings app, tap Appearance.

2. Select Automatic.

3. Tap Options to set a schedule for Dark Mode.


Learn how to use [Dark Mode on your Mac](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/mchl52e1c2d2/mac).

# Use a light or dark appearance on your Mac

You can use a light or dark appearance for the [menu bar](https://support.apple.com/en-vn/guide/mac-help/aside/glos33eb8abd/27/mac/27), Dock, windows, and built-in apps on your Mac, or automatically adjust the appearance from light to dark during the day.

![From left to right, samples of the Light, Dark, and Auto options shown in Appearance settings.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/8de2ca41-361c-47ed-9821-f22eb3efcf45)

1. Go to the [System Settings](https://support.apple.com/en-vn/guide/mac-help/aside/glos063f0019/27/mac/27) app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/68a037eb-fd33-493a-bb3a-9cc7784582ef) on your Mac.

2. Click Appearance ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/d35ae24b-8dfe-4207-8c8d-60b2c5400119) in the sidebar. (You may need to scroll down.)

[Open Appearance settings for me](x-help-action://openPrefPane?bundleId=com.apple.Appearance-Settings.extension)

3. Select Light, Dark, or Auto.

   - Light is a light appearance that doesn’t change.

   - Dark is a dark appearance that doesn’t change. Dark Mode darkens the color scheme so the content you’re working on stands out, while windows and controls seem to recede into the background. It’s effective for viewing documents, presentations, photos, movies, webpages, and more.

   - Auto switches the appearance from light to dark based on the Night Shift schedule you set. See [Change Night Shift settings](https://support.apple.com/en-vn/guide/mac-help/change-night-shift-settings-mchl9d976e85/27/mac/27).

     Auto won’t switch the appearance until your Mac has been idle for at least a minute.



     **Tip:** You can quickly turn Dark Mode on or off in [Control Center](https://support.apple.com/en-vn/guide/mac-help/aside/glos269670b4/27/mac/27). In the menu bar, click ![the Control Center status menu](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/f4f539f2-bf00-4034-8919-91970d44e8e6), click ![the disclosure button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/f5b5d496-b5f8-4677-920e-e05782a0b665) next to Display, then click Dark Mode.

In Appearance settings, you can also choose an accent color for buttons, pop-up menus, and other UI controls, and a highlight color to use for highlighting selected text.

Some dynamic wallpaper pictures may provide still images so the wallpaper doesn’t distract from the light or dark appearance. For example, if you chose the dark appearance during macOS setup, the wallpaper is set to a dark still image. You can change this picture. See [Wallpaper settings](https://support.apple.com/en-vn/guide/mac-help/wallpaper-settings-mchlp1103/27/mac/27).

**See also** [Customize the wallpaper on your Mac](https://support.apple.com/en-vn/guide/mac-help/choose-your-desktop-picture-mchlp3013/27/mac/27) [Use Control Center on Mac](https://support.apple.com/en-vn/guide/mac-help/quickly-change-settings-mchl50f94f8f/27/mac/27) [Change Appearance settings on Mac](https://support.apple.com/en-vn/guide/mac-help/change-appearance-settings-mchlp1225/27/mac/27)

# Customize the appearance of iCloud.com

On iCloud.com, you can choose a different background color for the homepage. Depending on your device’s settings, you can also use a light or dark appearance for the entire site.

## Change the background color of the homepage

1. Go to [iCloud.com](https://www.icloud.com/), then sign in to your [Apple Account](https://support.apple.com/guide/icloud/aside/mme7d59d02/1.0/icloud/1.0) (if necessary).

2. Scroll to the bottom of the homepage, then select Customize.

If you’re on iCloud.com but not on the homepage, select ![the App Launcher button](https://help.apple.com/assets/6AAB1A7B3D258762A20204E6/6AAB1A7EA2303D266D0C0FD9/en_US/d3ee72bc1a16de124510c4924003eab0.png) in the toolbar, then select iCloud Home Page.

3. Select Edit Background, then choose a color.

4. Select Done in the top-left corner of the window.


## Choose a light or dark appearance

![The iCloud.com homepage with Dark Mode turned on.](https://help.apple.com/assets/6AAB1A7B3D258762A20204E6/6AAB1A7EA2303D266D0C0FD9/en_US/99eda8614beecd8a246d6c4d7bc15f77.png)

Dark Mode gives iCloud.com a dark color scheme that’s perfect for low-light environments.

To use Dark Mode on iCloud.com, you need an iPhone, iPad, or Mac. When you turn on Dark Mode on your Apple device, you also turn on Dark Mode for iCloud.com. See the following:

- [Use a light or dark appearance on your Mac](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/mchl52e1c2d2/mac)

- [Apple Support article: Use Dark Mode on your iPhone and iPad](https://support.apple.com/108350)


For other ways to personalize your iCloud.com experience, see [Customize and use the homepage tiles on iCloud.com](https://support.apple.com/guide/icloud/customize-and-use-the-homepage-tiles-mm048a5aa9cc/1.0/icloud/1.0).

**See also** [Change your Apple Account photo on iCloud.com](https://support.apple.com/guide/icloud/change-your-photo-mm362334de5e/1.0/icloud/1.0)
